Proven from the TU code listing (work/asi/combat02/analysis/tu_all.txt); 'proof' = TU instruction words the sampler checks before it trusts the addresses. PC / retail counterparts for orientation. 2026-11-09, N18.

_comment_1b: 2026-11-09 stage 1b (TruXenia extension after the first live session): every section below has TU proof words; 'basis' says whether the meaning comes from TU code, Xbox data or the PC port (ENGINE.md).

lara_record.why: TU machine reset 0x82482808: r11 = [machine+4] (chart), r10 = s16 [chart+0] start index, r9 = [chart+0xc] record pointer array, r10 = [r9 + 4*index], stw r10 -> [machine+0x520]: +0x520 is a RECORD POINTER, its index is its position in [[machine+4]+0xc] (PC: [machine+0x510] / TruRockVein RecordIndex). Record layout (u16 header: +0xc state-id count, +0x18 pointer to the u16 state ids) as tools/chart_state_path.py reads the Xbox chart DTPs (big endian)

lara_health.basis: code; meaning 'health' from the PC (ENGINE.md section 3 player tracker +0x628)
lara_health.why: TU 0x823e8068..0x823e808c: r11 = [0x829892b0] (player tracker), lfs [r11+0x628] -> stfs [r11+0x634]; computed max -> stfs [r11+0x630]

enemy_test.why: TU enemy init 0x822da9ac..0x822da9e0: [inst+0x50] word 0 == 0xdaf00018 and byte +0x18 != 0 -> brain of 0x50a0 bytes is allocated (PC 0x63c1b5..0x63c1d3 the same test)

melee.raw_state_object_why: TU state switch 0x82349600: r11 = sm + idx*0x19c (0x82349688 mulli), data passed = r11+0x10 (0x82349700), state object stored at r11+0x1a8 (0x82349704 stw r30,0x1a8(r11)); the record sits at ((r11+0x1f)&~0xf)+0x50, so the state object is at raw+0x1a8 - aligned data+0x198 is 4 bytes off when the brain is 16-aligned (live 09.11.: always '?(data)')
melee.basis: code (data address, record pointer); +0x198 state object and +0x78 anim refs {u16 type, u16 anim} x3 from ENGINE.md 13.2 / 13.5 (same on all exes)
melee.why: TU MeleeAttack Enter 0x8232fb48: sm = brain+0x1254, slot = [sm + 4*(0x1a0+layer)] = [brain+0x18d4+4*layer], data = (sm + (slot + 2*layer)*0x19c + 0x1f) & ~0xf; record = [[arg]+0] stored at data+0x50; record +0x136 / +0x138 read

coordinator.basis: code (requester and its handle); meaning of the handle open
coordinator.why: TU MeleeAttack Enter 0x8232fce8: r6 = brain+0x2fc4, bl 0x823551b0(requester, target): 0x82355138 checks the handle {[req+4] instance, [req+8] stamp} ([inst+0x44] == stamp) and a field +0x20 of 0x823548b0(inst); then the target's slot manager 0x82354938(target)+0xf78 != 0. TruXenia logs the handle's instance (whom it points at) as raw data

regenerate_death.why: RegenerateDeath Enter TU 0x8235dff8 (vtable 0x8206ea40 slot 7, state object 0x8277a7b8 named RegenerateDeath, tools/xbox_vtable_owner.py): f31 = old LP [brain+0x2c64], LP := 0x822f8c18(health component) (the maximum from the current tune), then 0x822f8dd8(health, old LP) - so during RegenerateDeath the LP field holds the restored MAXIMUM, not damage; the Y finisher sets it to 0

meter_requests.fields: +0 player time scale request, +4 world time scale request (a value <= 0.0 = slot unused, so 0 and -1 are both empty); the HIGHEST slot with a value > 0 wins, player and world separately -> ramp targets
meter_requests.threshold: 0x8207d538 (0.0 in the TU image): 0x823d7558 lfs f11, -0x2ac8(r31); 0x823d7578 fcmpu f13, f11; ble -> skip the slot
meter_requests.basis: code; slot writers from docs Befund-X23-Kraftlauf-0911.md
meter_requests.why: TU 0x823d7d1c: addi r3, meter, 0x40 -> selector 0x823d7520: r5 = list+0x30 (slot 6), loop to slot 0 (r5 -= 8), lfs [r5+0] player / [r5+4] world; targets stfs [0x827754ac] (lis -0x7d89 / addi 0x54ac) and [0x827754cc] (addi 0x54cc)

object_table.basis: code (PC twin 0xdb7400, ENGINE.md section 2 'Object tracker table')
object_table.why: TU 0x8214684c..0x821468f0: r11 = 0x82979280, 0xcc entries of 0x24, u16 +0xe == 2 and u16 +0xc == id -> object pointer [entry+8]

camera.rotation_note: the getter PC 0x5e78a0 / slot 0x34 (+0xa0) was called 'position' in ENGINE.md and TruMenu 0.22.11 fight.trace; its values are a ROTATION (x pitch, y, z yaw in radians): TU dump dlc2_shadow_off_image.bin gameplay camera 0x82effab0 +0xa0 = (-0.0061, -1e-11, -3.083, 0), transform +0x10 rows (-0.998 -0.061 0) / (-0.0004 0.0061 -1.0) / (0.061 -0.998 -0.0061) / (621.4 118.1 -7479.8 1) = the same angles (forward = row 2 = (-sin z, cos z)), position row 3 = +0x90; PC TruFight.log 2026-11-10: pc_cam_dx/dy/dz = -Lara position (camera '+0xa0' near 0)
camera.basis: code (2026-11-11, camera comparison Xenia / PC: workspace docs/Plan-Kamera-Vergleich-Xenia-PC-1111.md); mode / flags offsets from ENGINE.md section 22 (Xbox +0x54 / +0x7c = PC +0x58 / +0x80); camera yaw = rotation z (+0xa8, getter slot 0x44), delta_yaw = camera yaw - Lara yaw (camera: forward = (-sin z, cos z) from its transform; the same convention for Lara's +0x38 is ASSUMED - checked by the L3 centre-camera calibration of the plan); look-at point not proven - '?' (the forward axis is transform row 2)
camera.pc: manager 0xe804f0, current camera [mgr+0x44], gameplay camera [mgr+0xb80] = 0xe83860 (focus +0x1cc), position = vtable +0x34 0x5e1c60 `lea eax,[ecx+0xa0]`, FOV = vtable +0x40 0x5e1c90 `fld [ecx+0xb0]` (vertical radians), camera matrix 0xe804a0, getters 0x5e7850 / 0x5e7870 / 0x5e78a0 / 0x5e78d0; focus getter 0x5e7920 = TU 0x822aabd0; recenter weight 0x5ffa90 (clock +0x1e4, S+0xb4 / S+0xb8), settings table 0xc36f28 (lookup 0x54df80, S = entry + 0x20 via 0x6026ea), GlobalInfo [0xe7ee50] +0x144
camera.why: TU 0x822a9a6c..0x822a9a90 (= PC flag reader 0x5e5e8e): r3 = 0x82efc780 (lis -0x7d10 / addi -0x3880), vtable slot 0xac (flag-bit-2 test) called on it. Current camera: TU 0x822aabd0 (= PC 0x5e7920, instruction for instruction) r3 = [0x82efc780+0x44], call its vtable +0x48, null -> [gameTracker+0xc]; gameplay camera: TU manager update 0x822ad048 (= PC 0x5f3c70) lwz +0xb50 next to +0x44 (PC +0xb80 next to +0x44). Base camera getters: LaraCameraRewrite vtable 0x82068c60 slot 0x34 = 0x822a3968 `addi r3,r3,0xa0; blr` (rotation), slot 0x38 = 0x822a3970 `addi r3,r3,0x10; blr` (transform), slot 0x40 = 0x822a3980 `lfs f1,0xb0(r3); blr` (FOV), slot 0x44 = 0x822a3988 `lfs f1,0xa8(r3); blr` (yaw = rotation z) - PC slots 0x5e1c60 / 0x5e1c70 / 0x5e1c90 / 0x5e1ca0 the same offsets; position = transform row 3 (+0x40, w = 1.0; data, see rotation_note). Recenter: vtable slot 0x84 = 0x822c20b8 (TU weight): S = 0x822bc198([cam+0x1d0]), clamp(([cam+0x1e4] - [S+0xb4]) / [S+0xb8], 0, 1); the look step resets / advances +0x1e4 (0x822c2ca0 / 0x822c2cd4). Settings lookup 0x822bc198: entry = [0x8287ba80 + 4*id] (id != -1), used when entry != 0 and byte entry+4 == 0, else id = [[0x829ca200]+0x144], or +0x14c when [[0x829892b0]+0x1244] != 0 (doppelganger); returns entry + 0x20. Lara yaw: TU 0x8242f990..0x8242f9a8 f1 = [[gameTracker+0xc]+0x38] next to the position vector +0x20 (PC reads [[0xe7f094]+0x38] the same way at 0x752c73 / 0x721e6e; ENGINE.md 5.2 instance +0x30 rotation, z = yaw)

_comment_sonar: 2026-11-14 PDA sonar (ping map) for TruXenia `sonar` (PC side: workspace docs/Befund-Sonar-Komplett-1411.md, ENGINE.md row 'PDA sonar reveal state'). The four sonar sections are 'optional': a mismatch there does not stop TruXenia, it only shows that section's values as '?'. Found with trudlcport/work/xsonar_1411/xsonar_tu.py (outputs next to it).

sonar.basis: code (TU); mode names from the PC switch (same jump-table shape)
sonar.pc: mode [0xee03c8] (switch 0x6e55f0, table 0x6e5638), stage [0x8afef8], progress [0x8afefc], tuning [0xee03e0] +0xc radius / +0x10 view distance (+4000 0x85d900)
sonar.why: TU per-frame switch 0x823d6f9c: r11 = [0x829ca5a4] - 1, cmplwi 3, table 0x823d6fc4 (1 -> 0x823d5af8, 2 -> bl 0x823d2100 = stage machine, 3 -> view, 4 -> 0x823d5e00); open 0x823d5690 (= PC 0x6e53f0): mode == 0 -> ... stw 1 -> mode; stage machine 0x823d2100 (budget li 0x1f4, stage [0x827599ec] cmplwi 3, progress [0x82759a80]) ends with stw 3 -> mode at 0x823d21e4; stage 0 0x823d1a40 radius = [[0x829ca5bc]+0xc] squared; draw 0x823d4540 (= PC 0x6e4130) view distance = ([[0x829ca5bc]+0x10] + [0x8207dfb8] 4000.0) squared

sonar_units.basis: code (TU); placeholder = the 'MAP' mesh of 100 faces / 56 vertices (Xbox data, workspace docs/Befund-Sonar-DLC2-1411.md)
sonar_units.pc: map unit list [0x8aff3c] / count [0x8aff34], unit 0xc0 B (+2 name, +0x84 key, +0x8c -> {mesh, water mesh}, +0xb0 floor mask, +0xb3 placed), current unit [0xedf254], floor mask [0xedf268], mesh +0x44 faces / +0x48 vertices
sonar_units.why: TU unit lookup 0x823cfd48 (= PC 0x6e2a60): r30 = 0x8277b2e0 {+0 count, +8 array}, strcmp(name, unit+2), new unit of 0xc0 B, +0x8c = 0, key +0x84; open 0x823d5690: r3 = lookup([0x82289980(...)]+0xc) -> stw 0x82987d40 (PC [0xedf254]); draw 0x823d4540 loop: unit = [[0x8277b2e8]+4i], [unit+0x8c] != 0, byte [unit+0xb0] & [0x8297f6e6], byte [unit+0xb3] -> bl 0x823d26f8 (= PC 0x6e3a00); unit draw: meshes [unit+0x8c] +0 / +4, faces [mesh+0x44], vertices [mesh+0x48]

sonar_reveal.pc: reveal entries [0x8aff18] / count [0x8aff10], entry 0x14 B: +0 key, +4 unit, +8 -> 2 bits per vertex (0 unknown, 1 revealed, 2 pending), +0xc vertex count (u16), +0x12 any revealed
sonar_reveal.why: TU entry getter 0x823cf980 (= PC 0x6e27d0): r27 = 0x8277b2bc {+0 count, +8 array}, match [entry+0] == [unit+0x84], new entry of 0x14 B: +4 unit, +0xc = (mesh0 +0x48 + mesh1 +0x48) clrlwi 16, +0 key, +8 = alloc((n+3)>>2), +0x12 = 0; stage 0 0x823d1a40: byte [entry+8][k>>2] >> ((k&3)*2) & 3, == 2 -> test

sonar_triangles.pc: triangle 0x6dfa60: cmp [0xee03e8], 0x16d83 / jbe -> draw, else [0xee03ec] += 1; both reset per frame at 0x6e41a1
sonar_triangles.why: TU triangle 0x823cf480 (= PC 0x6dfa60): r9 = lis 1 | ori 0x6d83 (93571), cmplw [0x829ca5c4], ble -> draw (counter += 1 at 0x823cf584), else [0x829ca5c8] += 1; draw 0x823d4540 resets both every frame (0x823d4560 / 0x823d4568); unit draw 0x823d26f8 calls it (0x823d294c). Same limit as the PC
